response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer (15+ years) with direct current experience in AI-agent infrastructure, MCP tooling, and agentic developer workflows at Staff level, plus a strong track record building low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems (e.g., million-requests-per-second microservices at Dunnhumby). His TypeScript/Node depth is solid and his current role aligns closely with the AI-native engineering mindset the role requires. The main gap is the complete absence of Python in his skill set, and limited explicit evidence of formal agile ceremonies, cross-functional stakeholder management, or on-call/incident response ownership.
strengths: Deep distributed systems and high-throughput experience (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby, DLang low-latency systems)
Currently hands-on building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, directly matching the AI-native engineering mindset required
Broad, multi-domain technical range (web, mobile, embedded, ops) suggesting strong systems thinking and adaptability
concerns: No Python listed anywhere in skills or experience, despite it being a stated must-have
No explicit mention of agile/scrum ceremonies, sprint cadence, or scrum champion-type rotation
Limited explicit evidence of formal stakeholder management or on-call/incident-response ownership in past roles
